title: fix(studio): retire Studio's Interfaces column (objectstack#36502)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_
Fixes #36502

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzj9RY8jKV57hUTNEYg

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- Studio 顶部只剩「数据、自动化、权限、全部元数据」，首屏是「数据」；旧地址 `/studio/<包>/interfaces`（含 `?surface=` 深链）落到数据页，提示「界面的修改已经搬到应用里」并带回到应用的链接。
- 只读包（如安装来的 HotCRM）里视图、仪表盘、报表、页面的「定制」入口，从「界面」搬到「全部元数据」里该条目的页面（席位已认可），定制和「恢复包原版」照旧。限制：这类包自带的列表视图，在应用里只能另存为个人视图，要改给所有人看的版本仍需进「全部元数据」（#35974 起就是如此）。
- 对外表单（#36444 未合并）暂时没有可视化编辑，元数据照常可改；PR #36784 需要的共用部件都保留。
- 删改合计约 3.7 万行（几乎都是删除），按规则需要您批准合并。

## What changes

The card (objectstack#36502), the maintainer's dispatch 「没关系，不等那个，现在就派」 (2026-11-24 05:17Z) and ruling record 7122806677 (the #36444 dependency waived; public forms stay metadata-editable; keep what PR #36784 needs).

- **Studio's top nav** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`): the Interfaces pillar (`InterfacesPillar`, about 3,600 lines) is gone. The pillars are Data, Automations, Access, plus All metadata. A package's Studio root opens Data (`STUDIO_HOME_PILLAR`).
- **Old links** (`studioInterfacesRetired.ts`, `StudioInterfacesRetiredNotice.tsx`): `/studio/<pkg>/interfaces`, with or without `?surface=`, redirects to `/studio/<pkg>/data`, keeping only `?changes=`. The Data pillar shows a one-line notice, 「界面的修改已经搬到应用里」 / "Interface edits have moved into the app.", with "Back to the app" (the same target as the header's ‹ Back to app) and Dismiss. The notice is latched when the landing arrives, so the Data pillar's own `?surface=` write and the Changes drawer dropping `?changes=` do not erase it. It goes on Dismiss or when the author switches pillar.
- **Producers re-pointed**: `studioChangesLink.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts` and `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts` print `/studio/<pkg>/data?changes=review`. The old `/interfaces?changes=review` still opens the drawer through the redirect. Console links that opened `/interfaces?surface=T:N` (`appRoute.ts#appStudioSurfacePath`, `artifactStudioPath.ts`, `metadataArea.ts`, `AiChatPage.tsx`) open the item's All-metadata page `/studio/<pkg>/metadata/<type>/<name>`, or `/data` for a built app.
- **Customize on a read-only base moves to All metadata.** In the running app, the view config panel is read-only for a view a read-only package ships (objectstack#35974), and View settings' Save offers only "Save as my view". So without this, retiring the pillar would have removed the only door that customizes a shipped view, dashboard or report into `<base>.custom`. `metadataArea.ts#AREA_CUSTOMIZE_EDITOR_TYPES` grows from `dataset` to `dataset, view, dashboard, report, page`. On a read-only base those items open `StudioBundleItemEditor`, with Customize, the type's registered designer (`ViewDefaultInspector`, `DashboardDefaultInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector`, `PageDefaultInspector`), the override chip and Restore. On a writable package they still open the generic item page. The seat accepted this route (seat note, 07:01Z), so it is not a deviation.
- **Docs and skills**: `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` (the dataset-context and reverse-bridge sections), `skills/objectstack-mcp-build/evals/draft-door-procedure.json` (the review link) and the plugin-chatbot `onDesignBuiltApp` doc example. No other user doc or skill names the Interfaces column (`git grep` over `content/docs` except releases, and over `skills/`).
- **i18n**: `engine.studio.interfacesRetired.sentence`, `.backToApp` and `.dismiss` (en, zh). The old `interfaces`/nav keys stay; the dead-key gate is report-only.
- **Checklist**: `studio-authoring.interfaces-create-dialogs` is retired (rev 5, with a retiredReason). `coverage.json` drops it from `app`, `page` and `report`; each still maps other items. `package-customize-restore-display` (rev 7) re-points its door to the item page. Eight more studio-authoring items, `dashboards.global-filters-rescope` and `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` have their Interfaces steps re-pointed, each with a revision bump and a history row.

### Item 5 census: what was deleted and what was kept

Deleted, because only the Interfaces column used it:
- Source: `InterfacesPillar` (in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, -3,624/+66 in that file), `InterfacesNavRail.tsx`, `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx` (its `StudioPicker` moved to `StudioPicker.tsx`, which the Access pillar uses), `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, `ObjectListViewTitle.tsx`, `ListViewTypeSection.tsx`, `ListViewChartSection.tsx`, `ListViewBulkActionsSection.tsx`, `ListViewMoreSection.tsx`, `interfaceCreate.tsx`, `metadata-admin/previews/SourcePageProperties.tsx`, and `services/componentRegistry.ts#listAppComponents` (declared, read by nothing).
- Tests: 80 files that drove only the pillar, its rail or its inspectors. About 30 more `StudioDesignSurface.*` files lost only their Interfaces cases. Pins of shared behaviour were moved, not dropped: `useNavTargetLabel.draftLabels-11862`, `AppNavCanvas.menuOrder-26979`, `studioZhPillarNames-11801`, and the kanban board's card-opens-record controls (objectui#12725/#12888), now in `plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/KanbanRenderer.cardOpensRecord-12725.test.tsx`.

Kept, because something else uses it or it is a shared export:
- What PR #36784 imports: `DataPillarHelpers`, `StudioCustomizeControls`, `StudioPillarKit`, `setup/publicForms`. Public-forms code and UI are untouched (the maintainer paused that development at 05:23Z).
- `StudioCustomizeControls` (override chip, Restore, `overrideDraftBody`), now serving the All-metadata editor; `StudioItemHeader`; `studio-canvas-preview` / `StudioObjectRecordsCanvas`; `useSurfaceDeepLink`; `navSurface`, `servedNavText`; `metadataError` helpers; `STUDIO_KIND_CHIP`.
- Shared nav-editing helpers with no Studio caller left, kept as exports: AppNavCanvas held-nav helpers, `nav-target` (`NAV_ENTRY_TYPES`, `navTypeAcceptsChildren`, `retypedNavEntry`), the `DraftTargetLabels` and dataset-create contexts (no provider today). Each is small; deleting them is a follow-up if nothing picks them up.
- The old i18n `interfaces` / nav-inspector keys (report-only dead keys).
- `ui/e2e/studio-item-header-title-width.spec.ts`: a fixture-only geometry pin of `StudioItemHeader`. Its last describe draws an "Interfaces leaf" from fixtures, so it does not depend on the pillar.

### Prerequisite cards (card item 1)

#36363 menu, #36366 header actions, #36364 add-menu-item, #36370 view settings, #36372 dashboard edit, #36374 report edit, #36425 internal forms retired, #36485 header Studio links, #36487 sidebar Design entry, #36498 and #36499 record page grouping and tabs: all closed as completed. #36444 (public forms) is open; ruling 7122806677 waives it. Until it lands, public forms have no visual editor and stay metadata-editable.

### Merge note

Against #36784 (head 1f9f2343), `overlap-check` reports one conflict: adjacent import lines at the top of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. #36784 adds `useHref` to the `react-router-dom` line; this PR drops the now-unused `useMetadata` from the `@object-ui/react` line. Resolution: take both. Every other file merges cleanly, and origin/main (7a5ae65e) merges cleanly. A later draft, #36888 (the Field layout tab, #36505), overlaps in `studio-authoring.json` and in two surface tests that both PRs gave the module-top `@objectstack/lint` import; whichever lands second rebases.

## Tests

- New: `studioInterfacesRetired.test.ts` (target, state, encoding); `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesRetired-36502.test.tsx`, through the real surface: bare URL → Data with the notice (en, and the zh catalogue string 「界面的修改已经搬到应用里」), Back to app, `?surface=` dropped, `?changes=review` keeps the notice, the notice outlasts the Data pillar's own `?surface=` write, leaving for another pillar takes it away, Dismiss, no Interfaces in the nav, and a CONTROL (a plain arrival on Data shows nothing). `metadataArea.test.ts` and `StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561` pin the moved Customize door: view, dashboard, report and page open the editor only on a read-only package; flow and object stay on the generic page. `copilotDoors-12894` pins that an old `/interfaces?changes=review` opens the drawer on Data.
- Re-pointed: every producer test, from `/interfaces?surface=` to the item page or `/data`: `appRoute`, `artifactStudioPath`, `metadataArea`, `AppHeader.*`, `PageView.*`, `SidebarAppMenu-36112`, `AiChatPage.noNavigationAfterBuild`, `notFound-26708`, `kernelReadOnly-29567`, `pillarNavGuard`, `metadataArea-28561`, `openPathObjectReaders-12811` (three rows for readers that left with the pillar).
- Local: app-shell `tsc` (src and test) exit 0. Vitest on the 820 test files that touch Studio, the console routes, i18n, plugin-chatbot and plugin-kanban, under the verify lock: 8154 tests, 9 failed on the first pass, all fixed and re-run green, with the affected files re-run after each later change. `@objectstack/runtime` `mcp-authoring.test.ts` (50) and `@objectstack/cli` `register-draft.test.ts` (10) green. Full `turbo build` green (120/120).

## Acceptance notes

- **CI round 1** (fixed in 8cfc5d6f): `check:test-source-alias` asked 14 edited tests for the module-top `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/formula` import; the spec-symbol ledger and the clickable-non-control census still listed the deleted `InterfacesNavRail.tsx` / `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx` and the retired rail's scrim; and the listed-manifests read had lost its only rejection handler with the pillar, which surfaced as unhandled 404 rejections in surface tests. All of `studio-design` re-run locally after the fix: 292 files, 2079 tests, green.
- **Live e2e** (CI-shaped: workspace backend via `ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, console `vite build` plus `vite preview` proxying to it). `studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` now customizes `showcase_task.in_progress` on `/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/view/showcase_task.in_progress`: Customize, then Remove Due Date in the view designer. That sends ensure 201 and a draft PUT to `package=com.example.showcase.custom&mode=draft` with the overrides block; Publish runs the pair's publish-drafts (200); the three reads serve the customized columns; the override chip appears; Restore sends two DELETEs at the pair and the shipped columns are served again. Green 4 of 4 runs. The whole `test:e2e:live:ci` allowlist: 23 passed in 1.7 min, which fits the job's two-minute budget.
- **Browser, zh-CN and en** (showcase): the Studio root opens 数据 / Data, and the nav reads 数据·自动化·权限·全部元数据 / Data·Automations·Access·All metadata. An old `/interfaces?surface=view:…` lands on Data with the notice in each language; Back to the app goes to `/apps/com.example.showcase`. `/interfaces?changes=review` opens Pending changes on Data with the notice. `/data?changes=review` opens the drawer with no notice. The metadata item deep link opens the editor. All metadata on the read-only showcase also opens a dashboard, a report and a page with Customize.
- **HotCRM walk** (hotcrm main 48082b7 on its published 18.6.0 backend, served by this branch's console): on Sales, the running app offers the design entries (sidebar app menu Design layout, View settings on lists, Edit on the executive dashboard, Configure tabs in the record ⋯ menu). No link on the home, list, record or custom pages points at `/interfaces`. The app menu's View in Studio opens `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/data?surface=object:crm_account`. All metadata opens `crm_account.all_accounts`, `executive_dashboard`, `sales_home_page` and `contract_print_page`, each with Customize. The custom page `sales_home_page` renders. The contract print page renders at `…/crm_contract/record/<id>/page/contract_print_page`, and Print Contract filed a 224 KB PDF through this console (print engine pointed at local Chromium). I checked that the in-app entries are present; I did not re-drive the menu, view, dashboard and record-grouping writes, which are the prerequisite cards' and were walked there. No HotCRM change is needed.
- **The Interfaces column's edit surface, against the card's table**: nav rail and nav-item inspector → design mode menu (#36363); header actions (#36366); New dashboard/report/page dialogs → design mode add-menu-item (#36364); list-view and kanban inspector → View settings (#36370); dashboard and report designers → in-page Edit (#36372, #36374); source and custom pages → no visual editor, metadata-writable (ruled). One row the table did not list is Customize on a read-only base, which now lives in All metadata (above).

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the redirect `<Navigate>`, the latched `retiredOn` notice state, `PILLARS`), `metadataArea.ts#AREA_CUSTOMIZE_EDITOR_TYPES`, `studioInterfacesRetired.ts`, and `ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` steps 1 and 2.

Two-minute check: open `/studio/<a package>/interfaces?surface=page:x`. Expect the Data pillar, the notice 「界面的修改已经搬到应用里」 and a working 回到应用. Then open a view of a read-only package under All metadata and expect Customize.

Governed reading (`check-governed-merges.mjs --branch`): Tier H. `skills/**` ×1 (`skills/objectstack-mcp-build/evals/draft-door-procedure.json`), and 37,094 changed lines (+1,489 / −35,605) is over the 3,000-line line. Not to be readied, queued or auto-merged by a seat.
